glosses: To move about rapidly and nimbly.

examples.text: A shadow flits before me, / Not thou, but like to thee; […]

There were many apes with faces similar to his own, and further over in the book he found, under "M," some little monkeys such as he saw daily flitting through the trees of his primeval forest. But nowhere was pictured any of his own people; in all the book was none that resembled Kerchak, or Tublat, or Kala.

examples.text: By their means it became a received opinion, that the souls of men departing this life, do flit out of one body into some other.

examples.text: My blender flits because the power cord is damaged.
